sources.title: Few-shot Adaptation of Multi-modal Foundation Models: A Survey
sources.snippet: Therefore, in this survey, we introduce and analyze the research advancements in few-shot adaptation methods for multi-modal models, summarizing commonly used datasets and experimental setups, and comparing the results of different methods.

sources.title: Few-Shot Learning Based on Multimodal Information Processing
sources.snippet: Few-shot learning aims to develop models with strong generalization capabilities using a small number of training samples. However, most learning methods rely solely on the visual features of a few samples to represent entire categories, leading to poor category representativeness. sources.title: Exploring Cross-Modal Flows for Few-Shot Learning
sources.snippet: Aligning features from different modalities, is one of the most fundamental challenges for cross-modal tasks. Although pre-trained vision-language models can achieve a general alignment between image and text, they often require parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) for further adjustment. sources.title: Multimodal Large Models in Few-Shot Learning Scenarios
sources.snippet: Multimodal large models (MLLMs) have recently demonstrated significant potential in addressing the challenge of few-shot learning across various tasks. By integrating information from different modalities such as vision, language, and audio, these models offer enhanced generalization and contextual understanding, which are essential when training data is limited.
